notes:
Starting point: all 35 test_MOD001 tests failed (view missing). Now 35/35 Tester tests and 5/5 test_MOD001_dev tests pass; round-trip passes; checks pass (sqlfluff advisory only: mostly CP02 on the FO/brnz upper- and mixed-case source column names, left as the sources spell them).

Implementation choices (each covered by a test_MOD001_dev test):
- Every lookup is OUTER APPLY TOP (1) with a fixed order, so no join can multiply rows: contact = the non-deleted brnz_contact with the lowest ContactId (SQL Server uniqueidentifier ordering), as the design says; payment-mode name = the lowest CUSTPAYMMODETABLE.RECID for the legal entity and code (FO keys that table by PARTITION too, so a code can repeat); country = the lowest dim_country.id for the country_id (dim_country.country_id has no unique constraint in dev).
- Payment date follows synapse_fo.vwCustTrans literally (DOCUMENTDATE <= '2021-08-23' as a datetime), as decided at test design sign-off: a DOCUMENTDATE of 2021-08-23 with a time of day uses TRANSDATE.
- Blank PAYMMODE and blank NAME are spotted with NULLIF(x, N''). Because = ignores trailing spaces, this also treats space-only values as blank.
- ISNULL is the outermost expression on the 'Unknown' fallbacks and is_corporate, so the view reports exactly the designed types and NOT NULL columns (checked with schema_lookup). Amounts are -AMOUNTCUR / -AMOUNTMST cast to decimal(32,6), with no rounding.
- Account and contact numbers are matched under the database collation (Latin1_General_CI_AS), as the design says. contact_number shows the matched brnz_contact value.

Test-first: the first run had 0 of 35 of the Tester's tests passing; the final run passed 35 of 35 and 5 unit test(s), in 3 run(s).
